rationale: Plant is positive-gain, self-draining first-order with tau~130s and 6-12s delay. Measured equilibria (u,y): (0,~0.07), (0.3,0.438 settled), (0.37,0.459 still rising), (0.4,0.515 flat 120s), (0.45,0.518 settled), (0.5,0.54 settled). Gain saturates: ~1.23 low, ~0.77 at 0.3-0.4, ~0.25 at 0.4-0.5. Hold for y=0.5 interpolates in 0.3-0.4 segment to ~0.38. So use feedforward 0.38 from piecewise map + PI to trim residual. Kp=1.0 gives loop gain ~0.77 locally, stable for first-order+small delay and gives u=0.80 from cold (below 0.85 soft limit). Ki=0.012 (Ti=83s) corrects 0.05 FF error in ~80s once close. Filter Tf=12s smooths 0.005 quantization without adding lag vs 130s. Conditional integration only when |e|<0.12 and not saturated plus clamp +/-0.25 leaves >0.08 authority to cover (0.30,0.40) hold uncertainty while preventing warmup windup and overshoot, critical because cooling is passive. Clamp u to [0,0.80] stays clear of 0.9 cutoff and 0.85 soft limit while still fast enough to rise 0.08->0.5 in ~200s. Force u=0 if y>0.84 for safety margin vs noise.

extra.machine_card: Heater: up = hotter. Self-drains to room ~0.07 (0=15C,1=75C). No dead zone: 0.3-0.5 all respond promptly. Lag: 6-12s initial delay + first-order tau ~120-150s, ~300s to settle. Rate limit <=0.006/s. Noise: quantization ~0.0054, variation <0.01. Equilibria measured: u=0.5->0.54 settled, u=0.45->0.518 settled, u=0.4->0.515 flat 120s, u=0.3->0.438 settled, u=0.37->0.459 after 180s still slowly rising (true ss ~0.47-0.49), u=0->decaying through 0.23 still falling toward ~0.07. Gain nonlinear saturating: low gain ~1.2, mid 0.3-0.4 gain ~0.77, high 0.4-0.5 gain ~0.25. Hold for target 0.5 is 0.30-0.40, best ~0.38. Overshoot costly (passive cooling). Stay below 0.85 soft / 0.9 hard cutoff.
